hook: Your radio could have heard the first satellite.
title: The First Satellite Was a Beach-Ball Beeper
description:
Sputnik 1 launched in 1957 and was only 58 cm wide. Its transmitter sent beeps that ordinary radios could pick up. Part of the series Places That Shouldn't Exist, from Earth to orbit.

#Shorts #Space #Sputnik
comment_prompt: Would you have listened in? Yes or no
